senses.title: Only for some
senses.definition: limited to one person or group and not shared with others
senses.definitionCN: 只属于某个人或某个群体，不与外人共享
senses.example: The company holds exclusive rights to the design.

senses.title: High status
senses.definition: used about places or groups that only wealthy or special people may enter
senses.definitionCN: 形容只允许富有或特殊人士进入的场所或群体
senses.example: They dined at an exclusive club by the river.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在河边一家高档俱乐部用餐。
senses.why: The closed door itself becomes a sign of status.
senses.whyCN: 紧闭的门本身就成了身份的象征。

senses.title: Single story
senses.definition: a news story printed or broadcast by only one newspaper or station
senses.definitionCN: 只由一家报纸或电台刊登、播出的新闻报道
senses.example: The paper ran an exclusive on the merger.

senses.why: One outlet owns the story, just as one owner holds the rights.

definition_zh: 专门地；唯独地；独家地；排他地；完全地
definition_en: in a way that includes only one person, group, purpose, or source and excludes all others
core_image: 一扇门只为一个名字打开，门上的名单短得只剩一行。
scene: 画廊开幕前，策展人说这批画只在这里展出。Before the opening the curator says these paintings are shown exclusively here and nowhere else.
sceneCN: 这里 exclusively 是「独家地、只此一处」（第 2 个义项：把展示的独有权只给一家机构地）；句意：开幕前，策展人说这批画只在这里独家展出，别处看不到。

pos.zh: 专门地；唯独地；独家地；排他地；完全地

senses.title: For one group only
senses.titleCN: 专门地：只对某一群体开放
senses.definition: in a way that is open only to a particular group of people
senses.definitionCN: 仅对某一特定人群开放地
senses.example: The lounge is used exclusively by first-class passengers.
senses.exampleCN: 休息室只供头等舱乘客使用。
senses.why: The adverb modifies the verb of access: the door opens for one list and stays shut for every other list.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词修饰‘进入’这个动作：门对一份名单打开，对所有其他名单保持关闭。

senses.title: Exclusive rights
senses.titleCN: 独家地：只授权一家媒体或卖家
senses.definition: in a way that gives one outlet the sole right to publish, sell, or show something
senses.definitionCN: 把出版、销售或展示的独有权只给一家机构地
senses.example: The interview was broadcast exclusively on the local channel.
senses.exampleCN: 这次采访只在本频道独家播出。
senses.why: Here the exclusion is contractual: other outlets are kept out by rights, so access itself becomes the product.
senses.whyCN: 这里的排除是合同性的：其他媒体被权利挡在门外，于是‘能访问’本身成了产品。

senses.title: Not shared with others
senses.definition: in a way that excludes sharing or joint use
senses.definitionCN: 排除共享或共同使用地
senses.example: The two researchers worked exclusively, never pooling their notes.
senses.exampleCN: 两位研究者各自独立工作，从不合并笔记。
senses.why: The word can separate people as well as things: each side keeps its own territory, and the boundary is deliberately maintained.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能把人分开：各自守住自己的地盘，边界被有意维持。

senses.title: Only, and nothing else
senses.titleCN: 唯独地：唯一依赖或唯一原因
senses.definition: solely; with no other factor or source involved
senses.definitionCN: 仅仅；不涉及任何其他因素或来源地
senses.example: Success depends exclusively on how well the team prepares.
senses.exampleCN: 成功完全取决于团队准备得如何。
senses.why: The exclusion is logical rather than physical: all other candidate causes are eliminated, leaving one factor that must carry the result.
senses.whyCN: 这里的排除是逻辑性的而非物理性的：所有其他候选原因都被排除，只剩一个必须承担结果的因素。

senses.title: Sole ownership
senses.definition: in a way that gives one party sole legal control or ownership
senses.definitionCN: 使一方获得唯一法律控制权或所有权地
senses.example: The company holds the patent exclusively.
senses.exampleCN: 该公司独家持有这项专利。
senses.why: Legal exclusion defines who may act. The right is not stronger because it is exclusive; it is exclusive because the law names only one holder.
senses.whyCN: 法律上的排除定义‘谁可以行动’。权利不是因排他而更强，而是因法律只点名一个持有人才排他。

senses.title: Entirely devoted
senses.titleCN: 完全地：把全部时间或精力只给一件事
senses.definition: with all of one's time, attention, or resources given to one thing
senses.definitionCN: 把全部时间、注意力或资源只给一件事地
senses.example: Her time was devoted exclusively to the dictionary project.
senses.exampleCN: 她的时间全部投入到词典项目。
senses.why: Attention is treated as a finite set: whatever is given here is simultaneously taken from everything else.
senses.whyCN: 注意力被当作有限集合：给这里多少，就同时从其他一切那里拿走多少。

senses.title: Separately, not jointly
senses.titleCN: 单独地：分开处理，不合并
senses.definition: in a way that deals with things separately rather than together
senses.definitionCN: 把事物分开处理而不是合并处理地
senses.example: The report treats the two periods exclusively, in separate chapters.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把两个时期分开，各用单独章节处理。
senses.why: This is the procedural sense: categories are kept apart so that each can be judged on its own terms.
senses.whyCN: 这是程序性义项：类别被分开，好让每一类按自己的标准被判断。

senses.title: Restricted purpose
senses.titleCN: 专款专用于：只许用于某一用途
senses.definition: in a way that limits a fund or resource to one specified use
senses.definitionCN: 把资金或资源限定在某一指定用途地
senses.example: The fund is used exclusively for student scholarships.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔基金只用于学生奖学金。
senses.why: Money is marked before it is spent. The restriction travels with the resource, so any other use would be a breach.
senses.whyCN: 钱在被花出去之前就被打上标记。限制随资源一起流动，因此任何其他用途都构成违规。

intro.en: Exclusively is exclusive plus -ly. Exclusive comes from Medieval Latin exclusivus, from excludere, to shut out. The adverb adds the Old English suffix -lice.
intro.cn: exclusively 是 exclusive 加 -ly。exclusive 来自中世纪拉丁 exclusivus，源头是 excludere‘关在外面’。副词再加古英语后缀 -lice。

items.en: To shut or close. The family includes include, conclude, seclude, and clause, all built from the image of a closed boundary.
items.cn: 关、闭。词族包括 include、conclude、seclude 与 clause，全部建在‘闭合边界’的意象上。

items.en: Ex- out plus claudere shut: to shut out. The verb creates an inside by keeping something outside.
items.cn: ex-‘向外’加 claudere‘关’：关在外面。该动词通过把某物留在外面来创造‘里面’。

items.en: Medieval Latin exclusivus meant ‘that excludes’. It shifted from the act of shutting out to the quality of a right or privilege.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁 exclusivus 意为‘排除的’。它从‘关门的动作’转向权利或特权所具有的性质。

items.en: English exclusive appears in the 16c, first in legal and commercial contexts where one party held a sole right.
items.cn: 英语 exclusive 在 16 世纪出现，先用于一方持有独有权力的法律与商业语境。

items.en: The adverb exclusively settled into general use in the 19c, when advertising and retail began to sell access itself as a mark of status.
items.cn: 副词 exclusively 在 19 世纪进入一般用法；当时广告与零售开始把‘准入’本身当作身份标志来售卖。

items.en: Modern usage ranges from neutral logic (depends exclusively on) to social signalling (an exclusive club). The adverb keeps the door image in both.
items.cn: 现代用法从中性的逻辑（完全取决于）到社会信号（高档俱乐部）都有；副词在两者中都保留‘门’的意象。

note.en: The first group is the exclusive family; the second compares adverbs of restriction, each limiting a different dimension.
note.cn: 第一组是 exclusive 词族；第二组比较表示限制的副词，各自限制不同维度。

entries.definition: restricted to a particular group or holder. The adverb applies that restriction to an action.
entries.definitionCN: 限于特定群体或持有者的；副词则把这种限制加到动作上。

entries.definition: the act or state of being shut out. It names the boundary, not the manner of acting.
entries.definitionCN: 排除的行为或状态；命名边界，而非动作方式。

entries.definition: the quality of being limited to few. It names the value of the closed door as a product.
entries.definitionCN: 限于少数人的性质；命名‘关着的门’作为产品的价值。

entries.definition: to shut out. It is the action that produces the exclusive arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 关在外面；是产生排他安排的动作。

entries.definition: for one reason or by one party only. It stresses a single cause or owner rather than a closed group.
entries.definitionCN: 仅因一个原因或仅由一方；强调单一原因或所有者，而非封闭群体。

entries.definition: no one or nothing else. It is the broadest limiter and can replace exclusively in many sentences.
entries.definitionCN: 没有其他任何人或物；是最宽泛的限制词，许多句中可替代 exclusively。

entries.definition: completely, with no part left out. It measures extent, not membership.
entries.definitionCN: 完全地，没有一部分被遗漏；测量程度，不涉及成员资格。

entries.definition: in a way that is peculiar to one thing. It stresses distinctiveness rather than exclusion.
entries.definitionCN: 以某物独有的方式；强调独特性，而非排除。

entries.definition: with nothing else mixed in. It stresses freedom from contamination or mixture.
entries.definitionCN: 不掺入其他东西；强调没有混杂或污染。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: exclusive plus -ly. The adverb tells you that the door was built for one name and closed on every other.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：exclusive 加 -ly。这个副词告诉你：门是为一个名字造的，对其他所有名字关闭。

normal.en: Ex- out, claudere shut, -ly manner: exclusively means in a shut-out manner.
normal.cn: ex- 向外，claudere 关，-ly 方式：exclusively 就是‘以关在外面的方式’。

normal.en: Exclusively for members: the guest list has one line.
normal.cn: exclusively for members：宾客名单只有一行。

normal.en: An exclusive interview: the other cameras are still outside.
normal.cn: 独家采访：其他摄像机还留在门外。

normal.en: Depends exclusively on: every other cause has been struck from the list.
normal.cn: 完全取决于：其他每个原因都已被从名单上划掉。

normal.en: A fund used exclusively: the money carries its own label.
normal.cn: 专款专用：钱上贴着自己的标签。

abstract.en: Exclusively always answers a silent question: excluded from what, and for whom?
abstract.cn: exclusively 总在回答一个沉默的问题：把什么排除在外，又为谁留着？

abstract.en: Scarcity can be made by rules as easily as by supply; exclusive access is manufactured scarcity.
abstract.cn: 稀缺可以由规则造出，也可以由供给造出；排他准入就是人造稀缺。

abstract.en: The same word describes a rigorous proof and a luxury club: logic and status share a door.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既能描述严格证明，也能描述奢侈俱乐部：逻辑与身份共用一扇门。

examples.en: The dataset is available exclusively to researchers who sign the agreement.
examples.cn: 该数据集仅对签署协议的研究者开放。

examples.en: He spoke exclusively in quotations, as if his own voice might give offence.
examples.cn: 他说话全用引文，仿佛自己的声音会冒犯人。

examples.en: The species feeds exclusively on one kind of fig, which makes it vulnerable.
examples.cn: 该物种只以一种无花果为食，这使它很脆弱。

dict_mnemonic.text: “一颗死路，只为一人开”——别的路都封死，只留一扇门：exclusively 专门地、唯独地。

root: 由 exclusive 加 -ly 构成；exclusive 来自中世纪拉丁 exclusivus，源头是 excludere（ex-‘向外’+ claudere‘关’），核心是“只对一方开放、把其余全部关在门外”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of exclusively, one structure: one door, one list, everyone else outside. The list may be a customer group, a media right, a research team, a cause, a patent holder, a project, a procedure, or a budget line.
sensesIntro.cn: exclusively 的八个义项共用一个结构：一扇门、一份名单、其余人留在外面。名单可以是顾客群、媒体权利、研究团队、原因、专利持有人、项目、程序或预算科目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door with a one-line guest list, everyone else in the corridor.
core.cn: 核心意象：门上一份只有一行的宾客名单，其他人都留在走廊。

chain: ONLY THIS GROUP USE CAUSE OR HOLDER

branches.en: THE DOOR OF ACCESS: a members' lounge and an exclusive broadcast both limit who may enter.
branches.cn: 准入之门：会员休息室与独家播出都限定谁能进入。

branches.en: THE SEPARATION LINE: not sharing work and treating periods separately both keep categories apart.
branches.cn: 分隔线：不共享工作与分开处理时期，都把类别隔开。

branches.en: THE LOGICAL KNIFE: one cause is left after all others are cut away.
branches.cn: 逻辑的刀：其他原因都被切掉后，只剩一个。

branches.en: THE LEGAL MONOPOLY: the law names a single holder.
branches.cn: 法律垄断：法律只点名一个持有人。

branches.en: THE FINITE RESOURCE: time and money are marked for one use and taken from all others.
branches.cn: 有限资源：时间与金钱被标记给一种用途，并从其他用途中取走。

intro.en: Exclusively is exclusive plus -ly. Exclusive is ex- plus claud- plus -ive, and the family also gives exclusion, exclusivity, and the verb exclude.
intro.cn: exclusively 是 exclusive 加 -ly。exclusive 是 ex- 加 claud- 加 -ive；词族还有 exclusion、exclusivity 与动词 exclude。

latinIntro.en: The Latin chain is claudere, excludere, exclusivus. The last form is Medieval Latin, so the adjective is a later legal development rather than a classical one.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁链条是 claudere、excludere、exclusivus。最后一个属中世纪拉丁，因此形容词是较晚的法律发展，而非古典形式。

items.meaning: restricted to one group or holder
items.example: The hotel has an exclusive beach.
items.exampleCN: 这家酒店有一片专属海滩。
门票只在线上出售。

items.example: The exclusiveness of the group discouraged newcomers.
items.exampleCN: 这个团体的封闭性让新人却步。

items.meaning: the commercial or social value of limited access
items.meaningCN: 独家性；排他带来的价值
items.example: The contract guarantees exclusivity for two years.
items.exampleCN: 合同保证两年独家权。

items.meaning: the act or state of being shut out
items.example: The exclusion of the witness changed the case.
items.exampleCN: 排除该证人改变了案件走向。

items.example: The price is 20 pounds, excluding postage.
items.exampleCN: 价格为二十英镑，不含邮费。

items.example: The test excludes anyone under eighteen.
items.exampleCN: 该测试排除十八岁以下者。

items.example: The fee includes two nights' stay.
items.exampleCN: 费用包含两晚住宿。

items.example: The writer secluded herself for a month.
items.exampleCN: 作家把自己隔离了一个月。

items.meaning: a closed-off section of a sentence or contract
items.meaningCN: 从句；条款（被收束起来的一段）
items.exampleCN: 该条款允许提前终止。

definition_zh: 排泄物；粪尿；（卫生语境）排泄污染物
definition_en: the waste matter, especially urine and faeces, that a living body passes out
core_image: 身体像一只筛子，把没用的部分筛出去，堆在外面
scene: 诊所的护士叮嘱村民，水井要离厕所远一些。The nurse warned the village that drinking water must be kept away from human excreta.
sceneCN: 这里 excreta 是「排泄物」（第 1 个义项：身体排出的废物总称）；句意：护士提醒村民，饮用水必须远离人的排泄物。

forms.label: 复数（本词即为复数集合形式）

senses.title: Waste expelled from the body
senses.definition: the waste matter that a living body passes out, taken as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 生物体排出体外的废物之总称
senses.example: Samples of excreta were collected from every household.
senses.exampleCN: 研究从每户人家采集了排泄物样本。
senses.why: Latin excreta is the neuter plural of excretus, the sifted out thing, so the word names waste as one collected mass rather than as single items.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 excreta 是 excretus 的中性复数，字面是「被筛出去的东西」，所以它把排泄物当作一整堆物质来称呼，而不是一件件东西。

senses.title: Urine
senses.definition: the liquid waste that the kidneys filter out of the blood
senses.definitionCN: 肾脏从血液中滤出的液体废物
senses.example: Urine is the liquid part of excreta.
senses.exampleCN: 尿液是排泄物中的液体部分。
senses.why: Because the collective noun covers whatever the body expels, its liquid half can be picked out and named on its own.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个集合名词覆盖身体排出的一切，其中液体的那一半就可以被单独挑出来称呼。

senses.title: Faeces
senses.definition: the solid waste that leaves the bowels
senses.definitionCN: 从肠道排出的固体废物
senses.example: Solid excreta were sealed in bags before transport.
senses.exampleCN: 固体排泄物在运输前被密封进袋子里。
senses.why: If the liquid half can stand alone, the solid half can too, and sanitation writing uses the word this way most often.
senses.whyCN: 既然液体那一半能单独说，固体那一半也能，卫生领域的文字最常这样用。

senses.title: Droppings of small animals
senses.definition: the waste passed by insects, worms, or other small creatures
senses.definitionCN: 昆虫、蚯蚓等小生物排出的废物
senses.example: Earthworm excreta enrich the soil around the burrow.
senses.exampleCN: 蚯蚓的排泄物使洞穴周围的土壤更肥沃。
senses.why: The same sifting image works for any creature, so the collective noun stretches down to insects and worms.
senses.whyCN: 「筛出废物」的同一个意象对任何生物都成立，于是这个集合名词向下延伸到了昆虫和蚯蚓。

senses.title: A sanitation hazard
senses.definition: body waste seen as a source of infection when it is not safely contained
senses.definitionCN: 未被安全收容时被视为感染源的排泄物
senses.example: Open defecation leaves excreta where children play.
senses.exampleCN: 露天排便把排泄物留在孩子们玩耍的地方。
senses.why: Once the word enters public health, the waste stops being mere matter and becomes a risk that has to be managed.
senses.whyCN: 这个词进入公共卫生领域后，排泄物不再只是物质，而变成一种必须被管理的风险。

intro.en: Excreta comes from Latin excreta, the neuter plural of excretus, the past participle of excernere, to sift out.
intro.cn: excreta 来自拉丁语 excreta，是 excretus 的中性复数，而 excretus 是 excernere（筛出）的过去分词。

items.en: Cernere means to sift, or to separate one thing from another.
items.cn: cernere 意为筛，或把一物与另一物分开。

items.en: The prefix ex- adds the idea of out, giving excernere, to sift out.
items.cn: 前缀 ex- 添上「向外」的意思，构成 excernere，即筛出去。

items.en: Its past participle excretus describes what has been sifted out.
items.cn: 它的过去分词 excretus 描述被筛出去的东西。

items.en: The neuter plural excreta turns that participle into a mass noun for waste.
items.cn: 中性复数 excreta 把这个分词变成指废物的集合名词。

items.en: Medical English borrows excreta as a collective term for what the body expels.
items.cn: 医学英语借入 excreta，用作身体排出物的集合称呼。

items.en: Public health and ecology extend it to animal waste and to pollution.
items.cn: 公共卫生与生态学又把它扩展到动物废物和污染问题。

note.en: Excreta sits inside the Latin family of sifting words, next to the plainer waste nouns of sanitation.
note.cn: excreta 处在拉丁语「筛出」词族之中，与卫生领域更朴素的废物类名词相邻。

entries.definition: solid body waste, usually faeces
entries.definitionCN: 固体排泄物，通常指粪便

entries.definition: to pass waste out of the body
the act of passing out waste, or the waste itself
unwanted material left after use
entries.definitionCN: 使用后剩下的无用物质

entries.definition: waste water and refuse carried in drains
entries.definitionCN: 下水道里的污水与污物

entries.definition: the liquid waste from the kidneys

normalIntro.en: Excreta is a plural mass noun from the Latin verb for sifting, so it names waste as something separated and pushed out.
normalIntro.cn: excreta 是来自拉丁语「筛」这一动词的复数集合名词，把废物说成被分离出来、推出体外的东西。

normal.en: Excreta belongs to the same family as excrete and excretion.
normal.cn: excreta 与 excrete、excretion 属于同一个词族。

normal.en: Public health texts pair it with human and animal: human excreta, animal excreta.
normal.cn: 公共卫生文献常把它与 human、animal 搭配：human excreta、animal excreta。

normal.en: Excreta disposal is the standard phrase for taking waste away safely.
normal.cn: excreta disposal 是「安全清运排泄物」的标准说法。

normal.en: The word is plural, so a plural verb follows: excreta were tested.
normal.cn: 这个词是复数，后面接复数动词：excreta were tested。

normal.en: Compare excrement, which usually means faeces only, while excreta covers urine too.
normal.cn: 对比 excrement：它通常只指粪便，而 excreta 把尿液也算进去。

abstract.en: Picture a sieve shaking the last useless grains out of the body.
abstract.cn: 想象一只筛子把最后一点无用的颗粒从身体里抖出去。

abstract.en: Picture a thin yellow stream running into a drain.
abstract.cn: 想象一道淡黄色的细流流进排水沟。

abstract.en: Picture a dark heap in a bucket behind a latrine.
abstract.cn: 想象厕所后面桶里堆着一团深色的东西。

examples.en: Human excreta must be kept away from drinking water.
examples.cn: 人类排泄物必须远离饮用水。

examples.en: The team tested samples of excreta from the farm animals.
examples.cn: 团队检测了农场动物的排泄物样本。

examples.en: Poor sanitation lets excreta reach the river.
examples.cn: 卫生设施不足，排泄物就会流进河里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读音接近「伊克屎瑞塔」，中间正好塞着一个「屎」字，和排泄物的意思对得上；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ cernere（筛、分开）→ excernere（筛出去、排出）→ 过去分词 excretus → 中性复数 excreta「被筛出去的东西」；核心义是「把无用的部分筛出体外」。

sensesIntro.en: One collective sense covers all body waste, then the mass splits into urine and faeces, then it reaches small creatures, and finally it becomes a public health risk.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是覆盖全部身体废物的总称义项，然后这堆物质分成尿与粪，再向下延伸到小生物，最后变成公共卫生意义上的风险。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sieve shaking useless matter out of the body.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只筛子把无用的东西从身体里抖出去。

branches.en: The collected mass of waste is the base sense.
branches.cn: 作为一整堆废物的总称是基础义项。

branches.en: The liquid half of that mass is urine.
branches.cn: 这堆物质里液体的那一半是尿液。

branches.en: The solid half of that mass is faeces.
branches.cn: 这堆物质里固体的那一半是粪便。

branches.en: The same image shrinks to insects and worms.
branches.cn: 同一个意象缩小到昆虫和蚯蚓身上。

branches.en: Waste that is not contained turns into a health risk.
branches.cn: 没有被收容好的废物会变成健康风险。

intro.en: Excreta is built from a Latin prefix, a Latin verb of sifting, and the English words that grew from the same root.
intro.cn: excreta 由拉丁语前缀、表示「筛」的拉丁动词，以及同一词根长出的英语词共同构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin cernere means to sift, and ex- means out, so excernere means to sift out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cernere 意为筛，ex- 意为向外，因此 excernere 意为筛出去。

items.example: The prefix ex- carries the waste out of the body.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 把废物带出身体。

items.example: Cernere supplies the image of sifting.
items.exampleCN: cernere 提供「筛」这一意象。

items.example: Excernere joins the prefix to the verb of sifting.
items.exampleCN: excernere 把前缀与「筛」的动词结合起来。

items.example: Excretus is the participle behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: excretus 是名词背后的分词形式。

items.example: Excreta is the neuter plural of the participle.
items.exampleCN: excreta 是该分词的中性复数。

items.example: Animals excrete what the body cannot use.
items.exampleCN: 动物排出身体用不上的东西。

items.meaning: the act of passing out waste
items.example: Excretion removes the waste of metabolism.
items.exampleCN: 排泄清除代谢产生的废物。
excrement 通常只指粪便。
粪便类废物需要小心处理。

definition_zh: 短途旅行；远足；离题；涉猎
definition_en: a short journey made for pleasure, or a brief departure from a main subject
core_image: 当天往返的一辆郊游巴士
scene: 学校组织了一次去海边的短途旅行。The school organized an excursion to the seaside.
sceneCN: 这里 excursion 是「短途旅行」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学校组织了一次去海边的短途旅行。

senses.title: Short trip
senses.definition: a short journey made for pleasure, usually returning the same day
senses.definitionCN: 为游乐而进行的短途出行，通常当天返回
senses.example: We took an excursion to the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 我们去老城短途游览了一趟。
senses.why: The group runs out and comes back within a day.
senses.whyCN: 一群人跑出去，当天又回来。

senses.title: Digression
senses.definition: a short period of trying an activity or leaving the main subject
senses.definitionCN: 短暂尝试某项活动，或暂时离开主题
senses.example: His lecture included an excursion into medieval music.
senses.exampleCN: 他的讲座中夹了一段对中世纪音乐的涉猎。
senses.why: The mind also runs off the main road for a while.
senses.whyCN: 思绪也会暂时跑离主路。

intro.en: Excursion comes from Latin excurrere, to run out.
intro.cn: excursion 源自拉丁语 excurrere，意为跑出去。

items.en: Currere means to run.
items.cn: currere 意为跑。

items.en: Excurrere joins ex-, out, with currere, to run.
items.cn: excurrere 由 ex-（出）与 currere（跑）组成。

items.en: Excursio names a running forth.
items.cn: excursio 指一次向外跑动。

items.en: Old French excursion keeps the journey sense.
items.cn: 古法语 excursion 保留出行的含义。

items.en: English excursion narrows to a short pleasure trip.
items.cn: 英语 excursion 缩小为短途游乐出行。

note.en: Excursion runs out for a short trip; incursion rushes in.
note.cn: excursion 是跑出去短游，incursion 则是冲进来。

entries.definition: a sudden attack into another place
a long digression in a text
a person on a short trip
a short trip away from home
a journey to a place and back
a journey visiting several places

normalIntro.en: Excursion is a short run out and back.
normalIntro.cn: excursion 是跑出去再回来的短程。

normal.en: A school excursion took us to the museum.
normal.cn: 学校郊游带我们去了博物馆。

normal.en: We went on an excursion along the coast.
normal.cn: 我们沿着海岸远足。

normal.en: The excursion train leaves at dawn.
normal.cn: 旅游专列黎明出发。

normal.en: A day excursion needs no hotel.
normal.cn: 一日游不需要住酒店。

normal.en: An excursion into history can be a digression.
normal.cn: 对历史的涉猎可能是一种离题。

abstract.en: Picture a bus that returns before dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆天黑前就返程的巴士。

abstract.en: Imagine a path that leaves the main road for an hour.
abstract.cn: 想象一条离开主路一小时的岔道。

abstract.en: Think of a quick leap out and back.
abstract.cn: 想象一次快速跳出又返回。

examples.en: The students went on an excursion to the hills.
examples.cn: 学生们去山里远足了。

examples.en: Our excursion lasted only one afternoon.
examples.cn: 我们的短途旅行只持续了一个下午。

examples.en: The chapter ends with an excursion into philosophy.
examples.cn: 这一章以一段对哲学的涉猎收尾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ curs（跑）＋ ion」——跑出去一小圈再回来，就是短途旅行。

root: 拉丁语 excurrere（跑出去）＝ ex-（出）＋ currere（跑）→ excursion，核心义「跑出去的一段短程」。

sensesIntro.en: Excursion means a short pleasure trip or a brief departure from the main subject.
sensesIntro.cn: excursion 意为短途游乐出行，或暂时离开主题的涉猎。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bus that returns before dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：天黑前返程的郊游巴士。

branches.en: A short pleasure journey is the core sense.
branches.cn: 短途游乐出行是核心义项。

branches.en: A digression runs off the main topic.
branches.cn: 离题是跑离主题。

branches.en: The trip usually ends the same day.
branches.cn: 这种出行通常当天结束。

branches.en: Both begin with a movement outward.
branches.cn: 两者都始于向外移动。

branches.en: The figurative sense keeps the running image.
branches.cn: 引申义保留了跑动的意象。

intro.en: Excursion combines ex-, out, with Latin currere, to run.
intro.cn: excursion 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 currere（跑）组成。

latinIntro.en: Excurrere gives excursio and then French excursion.
latinIntro.cn: excurrere 给出 excursio，再到法语 excursion。

currere 出现在 current 中。
excurrere 是直接来源。
excursio 加了名词词尾。

items.example: The suffix turns the verb into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 该后缀把动词变成名词。
excursion 保留当天往返的意象。
-ist 标记出行者。
excursionist 加上了表示人的词尾。

latinEntries.example: Excurrere is the source of excursion.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excurrere 是 excursion 的来源。

definition_zh: 可原谅的；情有可原的；可辩解的；可免责的
definition_en: able to be forgiven or defended, so that blame or punishment is not deserved
core_image: 一支笔把纸上的一行字划掉：字还在，却不再算数
scene: 学生迟交作业，因为家里停电了一整夜。The teacher said the late submission was excusable because the family had lost power all night.
sceneCN: 这里 excusable 是「情有可原的」（第 2 个义项：有正当的客观理由）；句意：老师说迟交可以原谅，因为那家人整夜停电。

pos.zh: 可原谅的；情有可原的；可辩解的

collocations.zh: 可原谅的延误（工程与法律语境）
可原谅的疏忽（法律术语）
可准许的缺席（学校与人事语境）

senses.title: A fault that can be forgiven
senses.definition: describing a fault or offence that deserves forgiveness rather than blame
senses.definitionCN: 形容过错或冒犯值得宽恕、而不该受责备
senses.example: A forgotten name is an excusable slip.
senses.exampleCN: 忘记一个名字是可以原谅的小失误。
senses.why: Latin excusare meant to free someone from a charge, so the adjective first marks whatever can be released from blame.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 excusare 意为把人从一项指控中解脱出来，所以这个形容词最先标记的是「可以被免于责备」的东西。

senses.title: Having a good reason
senses.definition: having an outside cause that makes the fault understandable
senses.definitionCN: 有外部原因使这个过错变得可以理解
senses.example: His silence was excusable given the news.
senses.exampleCN: 考虑到那个消息，他的沉默情有可原。
senses.why: A Roman charge could be answered by a cause, and that answering cause grew into the modern sense of a good reason standing behind a fault.
senses.whyCN: 罗马人的指控可以用一个「理由」来回应，而这个用来回应的理由，就长成了现代「过错背后有正当原因」的义项。

senses.title: Defensible in argument
senses.definition: able to be defended in words without being shameful
senses.definitionCN: 能够在道理上说通、不至于丢脸的
senses.example: The choice was excusable, though not wise.
senses.exampleCN: 这个选择可以辩解，虽然并不明智。
senses.why: If a charge can be answered, the act itself can be shown to be answerable, and that step from excusing to defending is this sense.
senses.whyCN: 既然指控可以被回应，行为本身也就能被说成「答得上来」，从「宽恕」走向「辩护」的这一步就是此义项。

senses.title: Free from legal blame
senses.definition: in law, not carrying blame or penalty because of special circumstances
senses.definitionCN: 在法律上因特殊情形而不承担过错或处罚
senses.example: The court treated the delay as excusable neglect.
senses.exampleCN: 法院把这一延误视为可原谅的疏忽。
senses.why: English law kept the Roman forensic core of the word and used it for conduct that a court will not punish.
senses.whyCN: 英国法律保留了这个词的罗马法庭内核，用它指法院不予处罚的行为。

senses.title: Allowed as an exception
senses.definition: accepted as a valid reason for missing work, school, or a duty
senses.definitionCN: 被接受为缺席工作、学校或职责的有效理由
senses.example: Illness is an excusable absence under the school rules.
senses.exampleCN: 按校规，生病属于可准许的缺席。
senses.why: Once a reason can lift blame, an institution can also accept that reason in advance, which is how the administrative sense appears.
senses.whyCN: 当理由能够免除责备，机构也就可以事先接受这个理由，行政语境里的义项就是这样出现的。

intro.en: Excusable comes from Latin excusabilis, from excusare, to release from a charge, built on causa, a legal case.
intro.cn: excusable 来自拉丁语 excusabilis，源于 excusare（使脱离指控），其词基是 causa（诉讼、案由）。

items.en: Causa means a legal case, a charge, or a reason.
items.cn: causa 意为诉讼案件、指控，也可以指理由。

items.en: Excusare is ex- plus causa, to take someone out of the charge.
items.cn: excusare 是 ex- 加 causa，意为把人从指控中取出来。

items.en: Excusabilis describes what can be released from blame in that way.
items.cn: excusabilis 描述能以这种方式脱离责备的东西。

items.en: Old French keeps the adjective as excusable, with the same legal flavour.
items.cn: 古法语把这个形容词保留为 excusable，法律色彩没有改变。

items.en: Middle English adopts excusable for faults that deserve forgiveness.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 excusable，用于值得宽恕的过错。

items.en: Modern legal English fixes phrases such as excusable neglect and excusable delay.
items.cn: 现代法律英语固定了 excusable neglect、excusable delay 一类说法。

note.en: Excusable belongs to the Latin words of charge and release, and it stands beside the plainer adjectives of forgiveness.
note.cn: excusable 属于拉丁语中「指控与解除」的词群，也与更朴素的宽恕类形容词相邻。

entries.definition: to forgive, or to give a reason for something
too bad to be forgiven
in a way that can be forgiven
able to be forgiven
small enough to be pardoned
able to be shown to be right
entries.definitionCN: 有正当理由的；可证明为正当的

normalIntro.en: Excusable keeps a Roman courtroom inside it: a charge is named first, and then the charge is lifted.
normalIntro.cn: excusable 里藏着罗马法庭：先有一项指控，然后这项指控被解除。

normal.en: The base is excuse, and the suffix -able adds the idea of can be.
normal.cn: 词基是 excuse，后缀 -able 加上「可以被……」的意思。

normal.en: Inexcusable is its negative, built with the prefix in-.
normal.cn: inexcusable 是它的否定形式，由前缀 in- 构成。

normal.en: Courts say excusable neglect when a delay has a real cause.
normal.cn: 法院在有真实原因造成延误时会说 excusable neglect。

normal.en: A school may record an excusable absence for illness.
normal.cn: 学校可以把生病记作 excusable absence。

normal.en: Compare pardonable: pardonable is warmer and more personal, excusable more neutral and legal.
normal.cn: 对比 pardonable：pardonable 更温暖、更个人化，excusable 更中性、更偏法律。

abstract.en: Picture a hand rubbing out one line on a page and leaving the rest.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手擦掉纸上的一行字，其余的都留着。

abstract.en: Picture a note about a power cut pinned beside a late essay.
abstract.cn: 想象一篇迟交的作业旁边别着一张停电通知。

abstract.en: Picture a lawyer answering a charge with one calm sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象律师用一句平静的话回应一项指控。

examples.en: A small delay is excusable when the cause is beyond control.
examples.cn: 当原因超出人力所能控制时，小小的延误是可以原谅的。

examples.en: The referee decided the foul was excusable.
examples.cn: 裁判认定那次犯规可以原谅。

examples.en: Nothing about that remark was excusable.

senses.title: Carrying out a plan or order
senses.definition: the act of putting a plan, order, or law into effect
senses.definitionCN: 把计划、命令或法律付诸实施的行为
senses.example: The execution of the new policy began in March.
senses.exampleCN: 新政策的执行从三月开始。
senses.why: Latin exsequi means to follow something out to the end, so execution is the whole path from a decision to the deed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 exsequi 意为「一路跟到底」，所以 execution 指从决定走到实做的整条路径。

senses.title: Putting a condemned person to death
senses.definition: the killing of someone as a legal punishment
senses.definitionCN: 作为法律惩罚而杀死某人
senses.example: The prisoner waited years for the execution to be carried out.
senses.exampleCN: 那名囚犯等了好几年，才等到处决被执行。
senses.why: A death sentence is an order of the court, and carrying that order out is still the same following through.
senses.whyCN: 死刑判决是法院下达的一道命令，把这道命令执行到底，仍然是同一个「跟到底」的动作。

senses.title: Performing a piece of music
senses.definition: the way a piece of music is played or sung in performance
senses.definitionCN: 一首乐曲在演出中被奏出或唱出的方式
senses.example: Her execution of the sonata was quietly confident.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这首奏鸣曲的演奏沉稳而自信。
senses.why: A score is also a set of instructions, and realising it in sound is another carrying out, so the musical sense grows from the same root.
senses.whyCN: 乐谱同样是一套指令，把它在声音里实现出来是另一种「执行」，音乐义项因此从同一个词根长出来。

senses.title: Producing a work of art
senses.definition: the making of a work of art or craft according to a design
senses.definitionCN: 按设计方案制作艺术品或工艺品
senses.example: The execution of the mural took three summers.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅壁画的制作花了三个夏天。
senses.why: When a design is followed through in stone or paint, the finished object is the result of that same carrying out.
senses.whyCN: 当设计在石头或颜料里被一路落实，成品就是那一次「执行」的结果。

senses.title: Skill shown in performing
senses.definition: the degree of skill with which a movement or a passage is performed
senses.definitionCN: 完成某个动作或段落时表现出的技巧程度
senses.example: The diver was marked on execution rather than difficulty.
senses.exampleCN: 那位跳水选手的评分看的是动作完成质量，而不是难度。
senses.why: Once the carrying out is watched closely, the manner of carrying out becomes something to judge, and that manner is this sense.
senses.whyCN: 当「执行」被仔细观看，执行的方式本身就变成可评判的对象，这个义项指的就是那种方式。

senses.title: Signing a document into effect
senses.definition: the formal signing and completing of a contract, will, or deed
senses.definitionCN: 合同、遗嘱或契据的正式签署与完成
senses.example: The lease takes effect on the date of execution.
senses.exampleCN: 这份租约在签署之日生效。
senses.why: A contract is only a plan on paper until its terms are followed through, and the signing is the legal moment when that following starts.
senses.whyCN: 合同在条款被落实之前只是纸上的计划，而签署正是这种落实在法律上开始的那一刻。

senses.title: Running a computer instruction
senses.definition: the process by which a computer carries out an instruction or a program
senses.definitionCN: 计算机执行一条指令或一个程序的过程
senses.example: The error appeared during the execution of the program.
senses.exampleCN: 错误出现在程序执行期间。
senses.why: A machine reads an instruction and then does it, which is the plainest modern copy of the old idea of following through.
senses.whyCN: 机器读入一条指令然后把它做出来，这是「跟到底」这一古老含义最直白的现代翻版。

intro.en: Execution comes from Latin executio, a carrying out, from exsequi, to follow out, built on ex- and sequi, to follow.
intro.cn: execution 来自拉丁语 executio（贯彻、执行），源于 exsequi（一路跟随到底），由 ex- 与 sequi（跟随）构成。

items.en: Sequi means to follow, and it also gives English sequence and pursue.
items.cn: sequi 意为跟随，英语的 sequence 与 pursue 也来自它。

items.en: Exsequi adds ex- to sequi: to follow a matter out to its end.
items.cn: exsequi 在 sequi 前面加 ex-：把一件事跟到尽头。

items.en: The noun executio names the carrying out of a plan, a law, or a sentence.
items.cn: 名词 executio 指对计划、法律或判决的贯彻执行。

items.en: Old French takes the word as execution, meaning performance or completion.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词写作 execution，意为履行、完成。

items.en: Middle English uses execution for carrying out a plan, an order, or a law.
items.cn: 中古英语用 execution 指执行计划、命令或法律。

items.en: Later English adds the death penalty, musical performance, and the running of a program.
items.cn: 后来的英语又加上了死刑处决、音乐演奏与程序运行。

note.en: Execution is the noun of following a thing through, and it stands beside the words of implementation, performance, and enforcement.
note.cn: execution 是「把事情做到底」的名词，与实施、表演、强制执行这几类词相邻。

normal.cn: 对比 performance：performance 是那场演出，execution 是做得怎么样。

abstract.en: Picture a dotted line running from a written order to a hand that acts.
abstract.cn: 想象一条虚线从写好的命令一直连到一只正在动作的手。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed order read aloud in a bare courtyard.
abstract.cn: 想象一份密封的命令在空院子里被当众宣读。

abstract.en: Picture a bow drawn across strings, one note held longer than written.
abstract.cn: 想象琴弓拉过琴弦，一个音比谱上写的多留了一拍。

examples.en: A good plan is worthless without careful execution.
examples.cn: 没有细致的执行，再好的计划也没有价值。

examples.en: The execution of the contract was delayed by a month.
examples.cn: 合同的签署生效推迟了一个月。

examples.en: Critics admired the execution of the final scene.
examples.cn: 评论家赞赏最后一幕的呈现。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读音像「埃克西Q神」：先把命令「审」清楚，再动手去做，就是执行；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外、彻底）+ sequi（跟随）→ exsequi（一路跟到底、贯彻）→ 名词 executio（贯彻、执行）→ 古法语 execution → 英语 execution；核心义是「把一件事跟到终点、做出来」。

sensesIntro.en: Execution begins as following a plan through, then hardens into the carrying out of a death sentence, then widens to music, art, and skill, and finally reaches law and computing.
sensesIntro.cn: execution 先指把计划贯彻到底，再具体化为执行死刑，随后扩展到音乐、美术与技巧，最后进入法律与计算机领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line drawn from a written order to the hand that carries it out.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条从书面命令拉到执行者手上的线。

branches.en: The plain sense is a plan followed to its end.
branches.cn: 最朴素的义项是：一个计划被跟到终点。

branches.en: A death sentence is an order that is followed through.
branches.cn: 死刑判决就是一道被贯彻到底的命令。

branches.en: A score is followed through in sound.
branches.cn: 乐谱是在声音里被贯彻到底的。

branches.en: Making and performing are both watched for the quality of the doing.
branches.cn: 制作与表演都要看「做得怎么样」，这正是技巧义项的来源。

branches.en: Law and machines both need formal following through.
branches.cn: 法律与机器都需要一套正式的贯彻过程。

intro.en: Execution is built on the Latin verb of following, with English words for doing, for the people who carry out, and for what can be carried out.
intro.cn: execution 建立在拉丁语「跟随」这一动词之上，英语里另有表示「去做」、表示执行者、表示可执行的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sequi means to follow, and exsequi means to follow a matter out to the end.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sequi 意为跟随，exsequi 意为把一件事跟到尽头。

items.example: The prefix ex- turns following into following through.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 把「跟随」变成「跟到底」。

items.example: Sequi is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: sequi 是整个词族的词根。

items.meaning: to follow out, to carry through
items.example: Exsequi adds completion to the idea of following.
items.exampleCN: exsequi 在「跟随」之上加上了完成的意思。

items.example: Executio is the noun of the finished act.
items.exampleCN: executio 是表示完成之举的名词。

items.example: Crews execute the orders they are given.
items.exampleCN: 施工队执行交给他们的命令。

items.meaning: the person who kills a condemned prisoner
items.example: The suffix -er names the person who acts.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 指执行动作的人。

items.meaning: concerned with putting decisions into effect
items.example: Executive power belongs to the branch that acts.
items.exampleCN: 行政权属于负责行动的那一支。

items.meaning: the person who carries out a will
items.example: An executor follows the words of a will.
items.exampleCN: 遗嘱执行人按遗嘱的字面去办。

items.meaning: able to be run by a computer
items.example: An executable file runs as a program.
items.exampleCN: 可执行文件会作为程序运行。

definition_zh: 主管；高管；行政的；执行的；高档的
definition_en: a senior manager, the branch that carries out decisions, or goods made for top staff
core_image: 顶层那间有最终决定权的办公室
scene: 董事会任命了一位新主管负责日常运营。The board appointed a new executive to run daily operations.
sceneCN: 这里 executive 是「主管、高管」（第 1 个义项）；句意：董事会任命了一位新主管负责日常运营。

senses.title: Top manager
senses.definition: a senior manager who makes important decisions in a company
senses.definitionCN: 在公司中做出重要决策的高级管理者
senses.example: The executive approved the new budget.
senses.exampleCN: 这位主管批准了新预算。
senses.why: The person at the top turns decisions into orders.
senses.whyCN: 顶层的人把决定变成指令。

senses.title: Administrative
senses.definition: connected with carrying out decisions and managing an organization
senses.definitionCN: 与执行决定和管理组织有关的
senses.example: The committee has executive power over spending.
senses.exampleCN: 该委员会在开支上拥有行政权。
senses.why: This branch of power is the one that acts.
senses.whyCN: 这一权力分支负责实际采取行动。

senses.title: High grade
senses.definition: designed for senior staff or wealthy customers
senses.definitionCN: 为高级职员或富裕顾客设计的
senses.example: They booked an executive suite on the top floor.
senses.exampleCN: 他们预订了顶层的行政套房。
senses.why: Even rooms borrow the status of the top floor.
senses.whyCN: 连房间也借用了顶层的身份感。

intro.en: Executive comes from Latin exsequi, to carry out.
intro.cn: executive 源自拉丁语 exsequi，意为执行到底。

items.en: Sequi means to follow.
items.cn: sequi 意为跟随。

items.en: Exsequi means to follow a task through.
items.cn: exsequi 意为把任务贯彻到底。

items.en: Executivus marks the power to carry out.
items.cn: executivus 标记付诸执行的权力。

items.en: French executif names the branch that acts.
items.cn: 法语 executif 指负责行动的那一支。

items.en: English executive extends to senior managers and luxury goods.
items.cn: 英语 executive 扩展到高级管理者与高档用品。

note.en: An executive decides and acts; a manager runs daily work.
note.cn: executive 决策并推动行动，manager 则负责日常运转。

entries.definition: the act of carrying out
a person who carries out a will
to carry out
a person who runs daily work
a person who manages an organization
a member of a company board

normalIntro.en: An executive sits where decisions become action.
normalIntro.cn: executive 坐在决定变成行动的位置上。

normal.en: The chief executive sets the direction.
normal.cn: 首席执行官定下方向。

normal.en: Executive power belongs to the cabinet.
normal.cn: 行政权属于内阁。

normal.en: An executive director sits on the board.
normal.cn: 执行董事坐在董事会里。

normal.en: The executive suite has its own lounge.
normal.cn: 行政套房有自己的休息厅。

normal.en: Senior executives met to discuss the merger.
normal.cn: 高级主管们开会讨论合并。

abstract.en: Picture a corner office with the final say.
abstract.cn: 想象一间拥有最终决定权的拐角办公室。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand that signs and the plan moves.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手签下名字，计划就动起来。

abstract.en: Think of the top floor where decisions are made.
abstract.cn: 想象顶层那个做决定的楼层。

examples.en: The executive team meets every Monday.
examples.cn: 高管团队每周一开会。

examples.en: She became an executive at a young age.
examples.cn: 她年纪轻轻就成了高管。

examples.en: They stayed in an executive suite for the conference.
examples.cn: 他们为参加会议住进了行政套房。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「execut（执行）＋ ive」——负责拍板并推动执行的人就是主管；属于决策层的，就是行政的、高档的。

root: 拉丁语 exsequi（执行到底）→ executivus（有执行权的）→ executive，核心义「把决定付诸行动的人与层级」。

sensesIntro.en: Executive means a senior manager, the branch that carries out decisions, or goods made for top staff.
sensesIntro.cn: executive 意为高级管理者、负责执行的权力分支，或为高层服务的高档用品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a corner office with the final say.
core.cn: 核心意象：拥有最终决定权的拐角办公室。

branches.en: The person who decides is the main sense.
branches.cn: 做决定的人是主要义项。

branches.en: The adjective marks the acting branch.
branches.cn: 形容词义标记负责行动的分支。

branches.en: The luxury sense serves top staff.
branches.cn: 高档义项服务于高层职员。

branches.en: Person and power both come from carrying out.
branches.cn: 人与权力都来自贯彻执行。

branches.en: Both point to the highest level.
branches.cn: 两者都指向最高层级。

intro.en: Executive combines ex-, out, with Latin sequi, to follow.
intro.cn: executive 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 sequi（跟随）组成。

latinIntro.en: Executivus comes from exsequi and passes into French and English.
latinIntro.cn: executivus 来自 exsequi，再传入法语与英语。

items.exampleCN: ex- 标记贯彻到底。
sequi 也给出 sequence。
exsequi 提供动作来源。
executivus 加上了形容词词尾。
-ive 构成形容词。
executive 保留顶层的意象。
execution 指这一行为。
execution 加上了名词词尾。
-or 标记执行的人。
executor 加上了表示人的词尾。

definition_zh: 例证；举例说明；是…的典型；印证
definition_en: to be a typical example of something, or to show it by giving examples
core_image: 从一整批货物里取出一件，举到灯下让别人看清
scene: 老师在黑板上写下一条语法规则，随后用两个短句把它讲清楚。The teacher exemplified the rule with two short sentences.
sceneCN: 这里 exemplify 是「举例说明」（第 2 个义项：用例子把抽象规则讲清）；句意：老师用两个短句举例说明了这条规则。

pos.zh: 举例说明；是…的典型；印证

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 exemplum 直接进入英语，指可供效仿的范例、典范
exemplar 加形容词后缀 -ary，义为「可作典范的、值得效仿的」
动词加 -ification 构成的名词，指「举例说明」这一行为或所举的例证

senses.title: To be a typical example of
senses.definition: to be a very typical example of a group, a style, or a quality
senses.definitionCN: 是某一类事物、某种风格或某种品质的典型例子
senses.example: This small bridge exemplifies the engineering of the period.
senses.exampleCN: 这座小桥是那个时期工程技术的典型代表。
senses.why: Exemplum is a thing taken out of a group to stand for the whole, so the verb first says that its subject is that sample.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 exemplum 指从一批东西里取出来代表整批的那一件，所以这个义项说的是主语本身就是那个样品。

senses.title: To give examples in explanation
senses.definition: to give one or more examples of something in order to make it clearer
senses.definitionCN: 举出一个或几个例子，使某件事变得清楚易懂
senses.example: She exemplified each rule with a sentence from the news.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一个新闻里的句子来举例说明每一条规则。
senses.why: The suffix -ify adds the act of making, so the verb moves from being a sample to holding samples up for a learner.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ify 加进了「做出」的动作，动词于是从「本身是样品」转成「把样品举给学生看」。

senses.title: To embody a quality in person
senses.definition: to show a quality very clearly by the way someone lives or acts
senses.definitionCN: 以某人的生活方式或行为清楚地展现某种品质
senses.example: Her career exemplifies patience and quiet courage.
senses.exampleCN: 她的职业生涯是耐心与沉静勇气的化身。
senses.why: When the sample is a person, the quality is seen living in one body, and the verb means to embody it.
senses.whyCN: 当被取出的样品换成一个人，品质就被看成活在某一具身体里，动词于是表示「体现、是…的化身」。

senses.title: To serve as evidence of a claim
senses.definition: to be a case that supports or proves a general statement
senses.definitionCN: 作为支持或证明某个一般性说法的实例
senses.example: The results exemplify the link between sleep and memory.
senses.exampleCN: 这些结果印证了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。
senses.why: A sample carried out of a record and shown could prove a claim, which left a quiet evidential sense in the verb.
senses.whyCN: 从档案里取出并当众出示的样品可以用来证明一项主张，这给动词留下了一层不显眼的「印证」义。

senses.title: To make a certified copy of a document
senses.definition: to make an official certified copy of a legal document
senses.definitionCN: 为法律文书制作正式的、经核证的副本
senses.example: The clerk exemplified the will for the court file.
senses.exampleCN: 书记员为法庭卷宗制作了遗嘱的核证副本。
senses.why: In legal practice a copy taken out of the official record was called an exemplified copy, and the verb names that act.
senses.whyCN: 在法律实务中，从正式档案里取出的副本叫 exemplified copy，动词就用来指这道制作手续。

intro.en: Exemplify goes back through Medieval Latin exemplificare to Latin exemplum, a sample taken out of a group, built on ex- and emere, to take.
intro.cn: exemplify 经中世纪拉丁语 exemplificare 上溯到拉丁语 exemplum（从一批中取出的样品），由 ex-（向外）与 emere（取）构成。

items.en: Emere means to take, to buy, or to take hold of.
items.cn: emere 意为取、拿、购买。

items.en: Eximere, from ex- and emere, means to take out or set apart.
items.cn: eximere 由 ex- 与 emere 构成，意为取出、单独挑出。

items.en: Exemplum is a thing taken out as a sample or a pattern.
items.cn: exemplum 指被取出充当样品或范本的东西。

items.en: Exemplificare joins exemplum with facere, to make, and means to make a copy or a sample.
items.cn: exemplificare 把 exemplum 与 facere（做）结合，意为做出副本或样例。

items.en: English borrows the medieval verb, first in the copying of legal records.
items.cn: 英语借入这个中世纪动词，最早用于法律文书的副本制作。

items.en: Modern English widens it to being a typical example of anything.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩大到泛指「是…的典型」。

note.en: Exemplify belongs to the family of exemplum, beside exemplar and the illustrating verbs.
note.cn: exemplify 属于 exemplum 这个词族，与 exemplar 以及一批「举例、说明」类动词相邻。

entries.definition: a model or a very good example of something
fit to be copied as a model
entries.definitionCN: 可作典范的；值得效仿的

entries.definition: the act of showing something by example
to make something clear with examples or pictures
to be a typical example of a group
to be the perfect example of something

normalIntro.en: Exemplify is built on a sample: ex- out, emere take, and -ify make.
normalIntro.cn: exemplify 的骨架是「取样」：ex- 向外，emere 取，-ify 使成为。

normal.en: An exemplum is a sample taken out of a whole group.
normal.cn: exemplum 就是从一整批里取出的样品。

normal.en: The suffix -ify makes the sample into an action.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ify 把这个「样品」变成动作。

normal.en: Exemplar and exemplary come from the same Latin noun.
normal.cn: exemplar 与 exemplary 出自同一个拉丁名词。

normal.en: To exemplify a trend is to be the case that shows the trend.
normal.cn: exemplify a trend 就是做那个显示趋势的实例。

normal.en: In law an exemplified copy is a certified copy taken from the record.
normal.cn: 法律里 exemplified copy 指从档案中取出的核证副本。

abstract.en: Lift one apple out of a crate so the whole crop can be judged.
abstract.cn: 从一筐苹果里举起一个，让人据此判断整批货。

abstract.en: Lay three short samples on the desk beside the rule book.
abstract.cn: 把三份小样品摆在规则手册旁边。

abstract.en: Watch a person walk, and the quality they name walks with them.
abstract.cn: 看着一个人走路，他所说的品质就跟着他一起走。

examples.en: The old market exemplifies the busy life of the port.
examples.cn: 这座老市场是港口繁忙生活的典型。

examples.en: He exemplified his point with a diagram on the board.
examples.cn: 他在黑板上画了一张图来说明自己的观点。

examples.en: Few buildings exemplify the style so clearly.
examples.cn: 很少有建筑能如此清楚地体现这种风格。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊格赞普利fai」——把「样品」举起来给人看，就是举例说明；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ emere（取）→ eximere（取出、挑出）→ exemplum（取出的样品）→ 中世纪拉丁语 exemplificare（做出样本）→ 英语 exemplify，核心义「把样品取出来示人」。

sensesIntro.en: Exemplify starts as the sample itself, then names the act of showing samples, then the embodying and evidential uses, and finally the legal copy.
sensesIntro.cn: exemplify 先从「样品本身」出发，再指「举出样品」的动作，随后长出「化身」与「印证」两种用法，最后还有法律上「制副本」的义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one item lifted out of a crate and held up to the light.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一筐货物里取出一件，举到灯下。

branches.en: Being the sample itself is the base sense of the verb.
branches.cn: 「本身是样品」是这个动词最底层的义项。

branches.en: Holding samples up for a learner is the explaining sense.
branches.cn: 把样品举给学习者看，就是「举例说明」义。

branches.en: A person as the sample gives the embodying sense.
branches.cn: 样品换成人，就得到「化身」义。

branches.en: A sample shown as proof gives the evidential sense.
branches.cn: 把样品当作证据出示，就得到「印证」义。

branches.en: Both the sample and the certified copy are things taken out of a whole.
branches.cn: 样品与核证副本都是从整体中取出来的东西。

intro.en: Exemplify carries the Latin sample noun exemplum plus the making suffix -ify.
intro.cn: exemplify 由拉丁语「样品」名词 exemplum 加上「使成为」后缀 -ify 构成。

latinIntro.en: The root pair is ex-, out, and emere, to take, which also yields eximere and exemplum.
latinIntro.cn: 词根组合是 ex-（向外）与 emere（取），二者还生成 eximere 与 exemplum。

items.example: The prefix marks something being taken out of a whole.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标记「从整体中取出」。

items.example: Emere is the taking verb inside the family.
items.exampleCN: emere 是这个词族里的「取」。

items.meaning: to take out, to set apart
items.example: Eximere joins the prefix to the taking verb.
items.exampleCN: eximere 把前缀接到「取」这个动词上。

items.example: Exemplum is the thing taken out and shown.
items.exampleCN: exemplum 就是被取出并出示的那件东西。

items.meaning: to make a copy or a sample
items.example: The medieval verb adds facere, to make.
items.exampleCN: 这个中世纪动词加上了 facere（做）。

items.example: The suffix -ify turns nouns into verbs.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ify 把名词变成动词。

items.meaning: to be or give an example
items.example: Exemplify keeps both the sample and the showing.
items.exampleCN: exemplify 同时保留「样品」与「出示」。
exemplar 指范本本身。

items.meaning: the act of showing by example
items.example: The long noun names the act.
items.exampleCN: 这个长名词指那道行为。

definition_zh: 被免除的；豁免的；免税的；免除；豁免
definition_en: free from a duty, a payment, or a rule that other people must accept
core_image: 值班名单上的一个名字被划掉，那个人不必再来
scene: 新规定要求全体员工参加培训，但夜班人员被单独列了出来，不用参加。Night-shift staff are exempt from the new training rule.
sceneCN: 这里 exempt 是「被免除的」（第 1 个义项：不受某项义务约束）；句意：夜班员工不受这条新培训规定的约束。

pos.zh: 被免除的；豁免的；免税的

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ion 构成的名词，指「免除、豁免」的状态或条例
否定前缀 non- 加 exempt，指「不在豁免范围内的、应缴税的」

senses.title: Not bound by a rule others must follow
senses.definition: not required to do something, or not affected by a rule, that applies to other people
senses.definitionCN: 不必做某件事，或不受某条适用于他人的规则影响
senses.example: Staff on the night shift are exempt from the new rule.
senses.exampleCN: 夜班员工不受这条新规定约束。
senses.why: Exemptus is the past participle of eximere, to take out, so an exempt person has already been lifted out of the group that the rule covers.
senses.whyCN: exemptus 是 eximere（取出）的过去分词，所以被免除的人已经被从规则覆盖的群体里取了出来。

senses.title: Not subject to a payment or tax
senses.definition: not having to pay a charge or a tax that other people pay
senses.definitionCN: 不必支付他人需要支付的费用或税款
senses.example: Books are exempt from the sales tax here.
senses.exampleCN: 在这里，图书免缴销售税。
senses.why: Money is treated as a list too: take an item off the taxable list and it is exempt from the charge.
senses.whyCN: 钱也被当成一份清单：把一件商品从应税清单上取下，它就免付这笔费用。

senses.title: To release officially from an obligation
senses.definition: to state officially that a person or a group does not have to do something
senses.definitionCN: 正式宣布某人或某个群体不必做某件事
senses.example: The ministry exempted small farms from the levy.
senses.exampleCN: 该部门免除了小农场的这项摊派。
senses.why: The verb turns the finished state into an act, and the actor is the authority that performs the taking out.
senses.whyCN: 动词把已经完成的状态变成动作，执行「取出」的人则是有权力的机构。

senses.title: To excuse from a rule by special decision
senses.definition: to allow one particular case to stand outside a rule, usually by a special decision
senses.definitionCN: 通常经由特别决定，允许个别情形置身于某条规则之外
senses.example: The referee exempted him from the qualifying round.
senses.exampleCN: 裁判特许他不参加资格赛。
senses.why: A single case lifted out of a general rule by a decision is the narrow use of the same image.
senses.whyCN: 由一次决定把个别情形从通则里取出来，就是同一个意象的窄用法。

senses.title: A person who is excused from a duty
senses.definition: a person who is not required to perform a duty that others must perform
senses.definitionCN: 不必履行他人必须履行的义务的人
senses.example: The exempts were listed at the end of the roster.
senses.exampleCN: 被免除义务的人列在名单末尾。
senses.why: Official writing turned the adjective into a noun for the people whose names had been taken off the duty roster.
senses.whyCN: 公文把形容词变成名词，用来指名字已被从值班名单上取下的人。

intro.en: Exempt comes from Latin exemptus, the past participle of eximere, to take out, formed from ex- and emere, to take.
intro.cn: exempt 来自拉丁语 exemptus，即 eximere（取出）的过去分词，由 ex-（向外）与 emere（取）构成。

items.en: Emere means to take, to buy, or to take hold of.
items.cn: emere 意为取、拿、购买。

items.en: Eximere means to take out, remove, or set apart from a group.
items.cn: eximere 意为取出、移走、从群体中单独挑出。

items.en: Exemptus, the past participle, describes someone already taken out.
items.cn: 过去分词 exemptus 描述一个已经被取出的人。

items.en: Old French exempt carries the legal adjective further west.
items.cn: 古法语 exempt 把这个法律形容词继续向西传播。

items.en: English uses exempt first as an adjective in law and taxation.
items.cn: 英语最初把 exempt 用作法律与税务领域的形容词。

items.en: Modern English adds the verb and the everyday school and tax uses.
items.cn: 现代英语补上了动词用法，以及学校里、税务上的日常用法。

note.en: Exempt shares the emere root with exemption, preempt, and the negative nonexempt.
note.cn: exempt 与 exemption、preempt 以及否定形式 nonexempt 共享 emere 这个词根。

entries.definition: the state of being exempt, or an official exception
to take something before another person does
not exempt, especially from a tax or an overtime rule
released from a duty or from having to attend
not affected by a rule, a disease, or a duty
to declare someone free of blame or of a duty

normalIntro.en: Exempt is a name crossed off a list: ex- out, emere take, so the person is taken out of the group.
normalIntro.cn: exempt 就是名单上被划掉的名字：ex- 向外，emere 取，人被从群体里取出来。

normal.en: Eximere is the Latin verb for taking something out.
normal.cn: eximere 就是拉丁语「把某物取出来」的动词。

normal.en: The past participle exemptus gives the English adjective exempt.
normal.cn: 过去分词 exemptus 给出英语形容词 exempt。

normal.en: Exemption is the noun, and nonexempt is its negative.
normal.cn: exemption 是名词，nonexempt 是它的否定形式。

normal.en: A tax-exempt item has been taken off the list of taxable goods.
normal.cn: tax-exempt 的商品已被从应税货物清单上取下。

normal.en: Compare preempt: same emere root, but prae- means before.
normal.cn: 对比 preempt：同一个 emere 词根，但 prae- 表示「在前」。

abstract.en: See one name lifted off a duty roster with a pair of tweezers.
abstract.cn: 想象用镊子把值班表上的一个名字夹下来。

abstract.en: See a price tag with the tax line cut away.
abstract.cn: 想象一张价签上的税额那一行被剪掉。

abstract.en: See a clerk stamp a form that lifts one farm out of a levy.
abstract.cn: 想象办事员在一张表上盖章，把一座农场从摊派里挑出来。

examples.en: Museum entry is exempt from the usual fee on Sundays.
examples.cn: 周日进入博物馆免付通常的门票。

examples.en: The council exempted the village from the new parking charge.
examples.cn: 议会免除了这个村子要缴的新停车费。

examples.en: Small firms often ask to be exempt from the reporting rules.
examples.cn: 小公司常常申请不受这些申报规定的约束。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊格赞普特」——名字被从名单上「摘」出去，就不必再做那件事；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ emere（取）→ eximere（取出、剔除）→ 过去分词 exemptus（已被取出的）→ 古法语 exempt → 英语 exempt，核心义「从规则名单里被取出」。

sensesIntro.en: Exempt begins as the state of being taken off a list, splits into duty and payment uses, then becomes the act of taking someone off, and finally names the people so treated.
sensesIntro.cn: exempt 先指「已被从名单中取出」的状态，分为义务与付钱两种用法，再变成「把人取出」的动作，最后指被这样处理的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name crossed off a duty list.
core.cn: 核心意象：值班名单上被划掉的一个名字。

branches.en: Being outside the group a rule covers is the base sense.
branches.cn: 置身于规则覆盖的群体之外，是最底层的义项。

branches.en: Taking an item off the tax list is the payment sense.
branches.cn: 把商品从税单上取下，就是与付钱有关的义项。

branches.en: The authority that performs the taking out gives the verb sense.
branches.cn: 由机构来执行这个「取出」，就得到动词义。

branches.en: A special decision for one case narrows the verb sense.
branches.cn: 针对个别情形的特别决定，是动词义的窄用法。

branches.en: The adjective and the noun name the same lifted out state and person.
branches.cn: 形容词与名词指的是同一种「已被取出」的状态与人。

intro.en: Exempt is built on the Latin pair ex- and emere, with exemption and nonexempt around it.
intro.cn: exempt 建立在拉丁语 ex- 与 emere 这一对成分上，周围有 exemption 与 nonexempt。

latinIntro.en: Eximere, from ex- and emere, means to take out, and its participle exemptus is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: eximere 由 ex- 与 emere 构成，意为取出，其分词 exemptus 是直接来源。

items.example: The prefix shows the movement out of a group.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀表示从群体中向外移出。
emere 提供「取」的意象。

items.example: Eximere is already a legal verb in Latin.
items.exampleCN: eximere 在拉丁语里已经是法律用语。

items.example: Exemptus is the form English borrows.
items.exampleCN: exemptus 是英语借入的那个形式。

items.meaning: free from a duty, to free from a duty
items.example: Exempt keeps both the state and the act.
items.exampleCN: exempt 同时保留状态与动作。

items.example: The suffix -ion makes the state into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 把这个状态变成名词。

items.meaningCN: 行为或状态的名词后缀
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 构成 exemption。

items.meaning: to take something before another does
items.example: Preempt uses prae-, before, with the same emere.
items.exampleCN: preempt 用 prae-（在前）接同一个 emere。
前缀 non- 构成 nonexempt。

definition_zh: 锻炼；练习；行使；运用；体操
definition_en: physical activity, a set task for practice, or the use of a power or right
core_image: 清晨公园里跑步的人
scene: 医生建议她每天锻炼半小时。The doctor advised her to exercise for half an hour every day.
sceneCN: 这里 exercise 是「锻炼」（第 1 个义项）；句意：医生建议她每天锻炼半小时。

senses.title: Physical activity
senses.definition: activity that you do with your body to stay healthy
senses.definitionCN: 为保持健康而进行的身体活动
senses.example: Regular exercise keeps the heart strong.
senses.exampleCN: 经常锻炼能让心脏强健。
senses.why: The body is kept busy and trained.
senses.whyCN: 身体被持续使用并得到训练。

senses.title: Practice task
senses.definition: a set of questions or tasks used for practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于练习的一组问题或任务
senses.example: The students finished the grammar exercises.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们做完了语法练习。
senses.why: Practice keeps a skill active, like exercise for the body.
senses.whyCN: 练习让技能保持活跃，如同身体的锻炼。

senses.title: Use of power
senses.definition: to use a power, right, or quality
senses.definitionCN: 使用某种权力、权利或特质
senses.example: The mayor exercised her right to veto.
senses.exampleCN: 市长行使了否决权。
senses.why: A right is put into action, not left unused.
senses.whyCN: 权利被投入行动，而不是搁置不用。

intro.en: Exercise comes from Latin exercere, to keep busy or drive on.
intro.cn: exercise 源自拉丁语 exercere，意为使忙碌、驱使。

items.en: Arcere means to keep away or drive off.
items.cn: arcere 意为挡住或赶走。

items.en: Exercere joins ex- with arcere and means to drive on.
items.cn: exercere 由 ex- 与 arcere 结合，意为驱策前进。

items.en: Exercere covers training the body and working a field.
items.cn: exercere 既指训练身体，也指耕作田地。

items.en: Old French exercice narrows the word to practice.
items.cn: 古法语 exercice 把词义收窄到练习。

items.en: English exercise adds the use of rights and powers.
items.cn: 英语 exercise 增加了行使权利与权力的含义。

note.en: Exercise trains the body; exorcise drives out a spirit.
note.cn: exercise 训练身体，exorcise 则驱赶鬼魂。

entries.definition: to drive out an evil spirit
a person or machine used for exercise
able to be used as a right
a period of physical training
repeated activity to improve a skill
teaching or exercise for a skill

normalIntro.en: Exercise keeps body and skill busy and strong.
normalIntro.cn: exercise 让身体与技能保持忙碌而强健。

normal.en: Take exercise before breakfast if you can.
normal.cn: 如果可以，早饭前锻炼一下。

normal.en: Physical exercise protects the heart.
normal.cn: 体育锻炼保护心脏。

normal.en: Do the exercises after each lesson.
normal.cn: 每课后做这些练习。

normal.en: The mayor exercised her veto power.
normal.cn: 市长行使了否决权。

normal.en: Exercise caution when crossing the road.
normal.cn: 过马路时要谨慎。

abstract.en: Picture a runner in the park at dawn.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明时在公园里跑步的人。

abstract.en: Imagine a page of questions filled in neatly.
abstract.cn: 想象一页练习被整齐地填满。

abstract.en: Think of a hand pressing a stamp of authority.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按下代表权力的印章。

examples.en: She exercises for forty minutes each morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上锻炼四十分钟。

examples.en: The workbook has exercises on every page.
examples.cn: 练习册每页都有练习。

examples.en: The board exercised its power to remove him.
examples.cn: 董事会行使权力免去了他的职务。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ erc（驱策）＋ ise」——把自己驱策起来动一动，就是锻炼；把权力拿出来用，就是行使。

root: 拉丁语 exercere（驱策、操练）＝ ex-（出）＋ arcere（挡住、赶动）→ exercise，核心义「把身体或权力反复用起来」。

sensesIntro.en: Exercise means physical activity, a practice task, or the use of a power or right.
sensesIntro.cn: exercise 意为身体锻炼、练习任务，或对权力、权利的行使。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a runner in the park at dawn.
core.cn: 核心意象：黎明时在公园跑步的人。

branches.en: Moving the body is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 活动身体是日常义项。

branches.en: Practice keeps a skill in shape.
branches.cn: 练习让技能保持状态。

branches.en: A right is put into action.
branches.cn: 权利被投入行动。

branches.en: Both senses repeat an action to improve.
branches.cn: 两者都通过重复动作来提升。

branches.en: Both turn something held into something used.
branches.cn: 两者都把持有之物变成使用之物。

intro.en: Exercise combines ex-, out, with Latin arcere, to drive.
intro.cn: exercise 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 arcere（驱赶）组成。

latinIntro.en: Exercere gives French exercice and then English exercise.
latinIntro.cn: exercere 给出法语 exercice，再到英语 exercise。

items.exampleCN: ex- 标记向前驱策。
arcere 也出现在 coercive 中。
exercere 是直接来源。
exercise 保留操练身体的意象。
-er 构成施动名词。
exerciser 加上了施动词尾。
-able 标记可能性。
exercisable 形容权利可被行使。

latinEntries.example: Exercere is the source of exercise.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exercere 是 exercise 的来源。

definition_zh: 呼气；呼出；散发出；喷出
definition_en: to breathe air out, or to send out a smell, a gas, or a vapour
core_image: 胸口一收，一股温热的气从唇间散进冷空气
scene: 他推开门，长长地吐出一口气，肩膀终于松了下来。He opened the door and exhaled slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 exhale 是「呼气」（第 1 个义项：把肺里的气呼出来）；句意：他推开门，慢慢地呼出一口气。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ation 构成的名词，指「呼气」这一动作或呼出的气体
动词加 -ant 构成的形容词，指「呼出的、用于呼气的」，多用于动物学

senses.title: To breathe air out of the lungs
senses.definition: to send air out of the lungs through the nose or the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 经鼻子或嘴把肺里的空气送出体外
senses.example: Breathe in through the nose and exhale through the mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 用鼻子吸气，用嘴呼气。
senses.why: Exhalare is ex-, out, plus halare, to breathe, so the word is simply breath moving outward.
senses.whyCN: exhalare 是 ex-（向外）加 halare（呼吸），所以这个词就是「气往外走」。

senses.title: To breathe out with relief or sound
senses.definition: to let a long breath out, often as a sign of relief or tiredness
senses.definitionCN: 长长地吐出一口气，常表示放松或疲倦
senses.example: She exhaled a long sigh and put down the phone.
senses.exampleCN: 她长叹一口气，放下了电话。
senses.why: A long outward breath is how relief shows in the body, so the plain physical act takes on the sighing sense.
senses.whyCN: 长长地往外呼气正是放松在身体上的表现，于是单纯的动作带上了「叹出」的意思。

senses.title: To give off a smell
senses.definition: to send out a scent or fragrance into the air
senses.definitionCN: 把香气或气味送到空气里
senses.example: The warm lilies exhaled a heavy scent.
senses.exampleCN: 温暖的百合散发出浓重的香气。
senses.why: A flower sends its scent into the air the way a body sends out breath, so the same outward motion names fragrance.
senses.whyCN: 花把香气送进空气，就像身体把气送出去，同一个向外的动作于是也指「散发香气」。

senses.title: To emit steam or gas
senses.definition: to push out steam, gas, or vapour, as a pipe, a vent, or a volcano does
senses.definitionCN: 像管道、通气口或火山那样把蒸汽、气体或烟雾推出来
senses.example: The vent exhales steam every few minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 这个通气口每隔几分钟喷出一股蒸汽。
senses.why: Pipes and vents push vapour out in pulses, and technical writing borrowed the breathing verb for that motion.
senses.whyCN: 管道和通气口一阵一阵把蒸汽推出来，技术文字就借这个「呼吸」动词来描写这种运动。

intro.en: Exhale comes from Latin exhalare, built from ex-, out, and halare, to breathe.
intro.cn: exhale 来自拉丁语 exhalare，由 ex-（向外）与 halare（呼吸）构成。

items.en: Halare means to breathe or to blow.
items.cn: halare 意为呼吸、吹气。

items.en: Halitus is a breath or a vapour given off.
items.cn: halitus 指一次呼吸或散发出的气。

items.en: Exhalare means to breathe out or to give off vapour.
items.cn: exhalare 意为呼出、散发出气。

items.en: Old French exhaler passes the verb into French use.
items.cn: 古法语 exhaler 把这个动词带入法语。

items.en: English takes the learned verb from French and Latin in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪从法语与拉丁语借入这个书面动词。

items.en: Modern English extends it to scents, vents, and machines.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到香气、通气口与机器。

note.en: Exhale pairs with inhale through the same halare root, and with breathing out verbs such as expire.
note.cn: exhale 与 inhale 通过同一个 halare 词根成对，也与 expire 一类「呼气」动词相邻。

entries.definition: to draw air into the lungs
the act of breathing out, or the vapour given off
bad breath
to breathe out, or to come to an end
to send out light, sound, gas, or smell
to breathe out slowly and audibly

normalIntro.en: Exhale is ex- plus halare, the Latin verb to breathe: breath going out.
normalIntro.cn: exhale 是 ex- 加上拉丁语动词 halare（呼吸）：气向外走。

normal.en: Halare is the Latin verb for breathing.
normal.cn: halare 就是拉丁语里「呼吸」的动词。

normal.en: Inhale has in-, exhale has ex-, so the pair marks the two directions of air.
normal.cn: inhale 带 in-，exhale 带 ex-，这一对词标出气的两个方向。

normal.en: Halitus, a breath, also gives the medical word halitosis.
normal.cn: halitus（气息）还给出医学词 halitosis。

normal.en: Exhalation is the noun for the act or for the vapour given off.
normal.cn: exhalation 是名词，指这一动作或散发出来的气。

normal.en: Flowers exhale scent just as lungs exhale air.
normal.cn: 花散发香气，正如肺呼出空气。

abstract.en: See a warm cloud leave your lips on a cold morning.
abstract.cn: 想象冷天的早晨，一团白气离开你的嘴唇。

abstract.en: See a long sigh push the shoulders down.
abstract.cn: 想象一声长叹把肩膀压了下去。

abstract.en: See a lily sending its scent out like a slow breath.
abstract.cn: 想象一朵百合像缓慢的呼吸一样把香气送出去。

examples.en: Breathe in for four counts and exhale for six.
examples.cn: 吸气数四下，呼气数六下。

examples.en: The pipe exhales a thin cloud of steam.
examples.cn: 管子喷出一缕稀薄的蒸汽。

examples.en: She exhaled slowly before answering the question.
examples.cn: 回答问题之前，她慢慢地呼出一口气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊克斯黑尔」——像拉风箱一样把胸口的气「呼」出去；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ halare（呼吸）→ exhalare（呼出、散出）→ 古法语 exhaler → 英语 exhale，核心义「气向外走」。

sensesIntro.en: Exhale moves from the plain breath out, to the sigh, to the scent a plant gives off, and to vapour pushed out by a vent or a pipe.
sensesIntro.cn: exhale 从「把气呼出」这一基本动作，扩到「叹出一口气」，再到植物「散发香气」，最后到管道「喷出蒸汽」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a warm breath leaving the lips into cold air.
core.cn: 核心意象：一口温热的气从唇间散进冷空气。

branches.en: The plain outward breath is the base sense.
branches.cn: 把气往外呼，是最基本的义项。

branches.en: A marked, audible outward breath gives the sighing sense.
branches.cn: 明显而带声的向外呼气，给出「叹出」义。

branches.en: Scent leaving a flower is breath leaving a body.
branches.cn: 香气离开花，正像气离开身体。

branches.en: Steam pushed from a vent is the technical extension.
branches.cn: 蒸汽被通气口推出，是技术领域的延伸。

branches.en: Both the lungs and the flower send something outward into the air.
branches.cn: 肺与花都是把某种东西往外送进空气。

intro.en: Exhale is a two part Latin verb: ex-, out, and halare, to breathe, with the noun exhalation beside it.
intro.cn: exhale 是一个两段式拉丁动词：ex-（向外）与 halare（呼吸），旁边还有名词 exhalation。

latinIntro.en: Halare, to breathe, and halitus, a breath, are the Latin words behind the English verb.

items.example: The prefix directs the breath outward.

scene: 跑完马拉松后，他精疲力尽地倒在草地上。After the marathon he was exhausted and fell onto the grass.

senses.title: Make very tired
senses.definition: to make someone feel extremely tired
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到极度疲惫
senses.example: The long climb exhausted the whole group.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的攀爬让整队人精疲力尽。
senses.why: Energy is drawn out until little is left.
senses.whyCN: 能量被抽走，所剩无几。

senses.title: Use up
senses.definition: to use something until none is left
senses.definitionCN: 使用某物直到一点都不剩
senses.example: The country exhausted its oil reserves.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家耗尽了石油储备。
senses.why: The well is pumped dry.
senses.whyCN: 水井被抽干。

senses.title: Waste gas
senses.definition: the gas or pipe that carries burned fuel away from an engine
senses.definitionCN: 发动机排出的废气，或输送废气的管道
senses.example: The truck poured black exhaust into the air.
senses.exampleCN: 卡车把黑色废气排到空气中。
senses.why: What is drawn out of the engine is pushed away.
senses.whyCN: 从发动机里抽出的东西被排走。

intro.en: Exhaust comes from Latin exhaurire, to draw water out.
intro.cn: exhaust 源自拉丁语 exhaurire，意为把水抽出。

items.en: Haurire means to draw water.
items.cn: haurire 意为汲水。

items.en: Exhaurire joins ex-, out, with haurire, to draw.
items.cn: exhaurire 由 ex-（出）与 haurire（汲）组成。

items.en: Exhaurire means to drain a well or spend a fortune.
items.cn: exhaurire 意为抽干水井或花光财产。

items.en: English exhaust keeps the image of drawing dry.
items.cn: 英语 exhaust 保留抽干的意象。

items.en: Exhaust also names the gas from an engine.
items.cn: exhaust 又用来指发动机排出的气体。

note.en: Exhausted means drained; exhaustive means complete.
note.cn: exhausted 是被抽干、精疲力尽，exhaustive 则是彻底的。

normalIntro.en: Exhaust draws energy or fuel out until nothing is left.
normalIntro.cn: exhaust 把能量或燃料抽出，直到一点不剩。

normal.en: The climb exhausted the young hikers.
normal.cn: 这次攀登让年轻徒步者精疲力尽。

normal.en: We must not exhaust the water supply.
normal.cn: 我们不能耗尽水源。

normal.en: Exhaust fumes filled the narrow street.
normal.cn: 尾气弥漫在狭窄的街道上。

normal.en: The old car has a broken exhaust pipe.
normal.cn: 那辆旧车的排气管坏了。

normal.en: She was exhausted from three night shifts.
normal.cn: 她因为连上三个夜班而精疲力尽。

abstract.en: Picture a well pumped until the bottom shows.
abstract.cn: 想象一口被抽到见底的井。

abstract.en: Imagine a battery drained to zero.
abstract.cn: 想象一块电量归零的电池。

abstract.en: Think of smoke leaving a pipe and drifting away.
abstract.cn: 想象烟从管子里冒出并飘散。

examples.en: The heat exhausted everyone in the hall.
examples.cn: 高温让大厅里所有人都疲惫不堪。

examples.en: Years of mining exhausted the hills.
examples.cn: 多年开采耗尽了这些山丘的资源。

examples.en: Black exhaust rose from the old bus.
examples.cn: 黑烟从那辆旧巴士上冒出。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ haust（抽）」——把水和力气都抽出去，人就精疲力尽，资源也用光；剩下的废气也被排出去。

root: 拉丁语 exhaurire（把水抽出）＝ ex-（出）＋ haurire（汲水）→ exhaust，核心义「抽出到干」。

sensesIntro.en: Exhaust means to make very tired, to use up completely, or the waste gas of an engine.
sensesIntro.cn: exhaust 意为使精疲力尽、彻底耗尽，或发动机排出的废气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a well pumped dry.
core.cn: 核心意象：被抽干的一口井。

branches.en: Drained energy leaves a person tired.
branches.cn: 能量被抽走，人就疲惫。

branches.en: Resources are pumped until empty.
branches.cn: 资源被抽到空空如也。

branches.en: The gas is what the engine pushes out.
branches.cn: 废气是发动机排出的东西。

branches.en: Tiredness and empty supplies share the drain.
branches.cn: 疲惫与空储备共享抽干这一意象。

branches.en: What is taken out must also go somewhere.
branches.cn: 被抽出的东西总要有去处。

intro.cn: exhaust 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 haurire（汲水）组成。

definition_zh: 可耗尽的；可穷尽的；可抽干的
definition_en: able to be used up, worn out, or emptied completely
core_image: 一只水桶被一勺一勺舀空，最后桶底见光
scene: 煤和石油都是会挖完的能源，用掉一点就少一点。Coal and oil are exhaustible resources.
sceneCN: 这里 exhaustible 是「可耗尽的」（第 1 个义项：资源会被用完）；句意：煤和石油都是会用完的资源。

pos.zh: 可耗尽的；可穷尽的；可抽干的

derivatives.zh: exhaustible 去掉后缀后的动词，指「耗尽、使精疲力竭」
动词加 -ion 构成的名词，指「耗尽」或「极度疲惫」
否定前缀 in- 加 exhaustible，指「取之不尽的、无穷无尽的」

senses.title: Able to be used up as a resource
senses.definition: able to be used until nothing is left, as a fuel or a mineral can be
senses.definitionCN: 可以被一直用到一点不剩，如燃料或矿物
senses.example: Oil is an exhaustible resource, and the price reflects that.
senses.exampleCN: 石油是可耗尽的资源，价格也反映了这一点。
senses.why: Exhaurire means to drain a vessel dry, and -ible means able to be, so a fuel is exhaustible when it can be drained.
senses.whyCN: exhaurire 意为把容器抽干，-ible 表示「可以被…」，所以能被抽干的燃料就是可耗尽的。

senses.title: Able to be worn away
senses.titleCN: 可被消磨尽的（精力、耐心）
senses.definition: able to be worn down or used up, as strength, patience, or goodwill can be
senses.definitionCN: 可以被一点点磨损或耗尽，如力气、耐心或善意
senses.example: Her patience, though deep, proved exhaustible.
senses.exampleCN: 她的耐心虽然深厚，最终还是被消磨尽了。
senses.why: Patience and strength were pictured as stored liquid, so the draining image applies to a supply of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 耐心和力气被想象成储存的液体，于是「抽干」的意象也能用在情感的存量上。

senses.title: Able to be pumped dry
senses.definition: able to have its liquid or its contents pumped out completely
senses.definitionCN: 其中的液体或内容物可以被完全抽出来
senses.example: The well is shallow and easily exhaustible.
senses.exampleCN: 这口井很浅，很容易被抽干。
senses.why: Haurire is first of all to draw water, so a well or a tank is the most literal thing that can be exhausted.
senses.whyCN: haurire 的本义就是汲水，所以水井和水罐是最字面意义上「可被抽干」的东西。

senses.title: Able to be listed completely
senses.definition: able to be dealt with so fully that no case is left, as a set or a list can be
senses.definitionCN: 可以被处理到一种情形都不剩，如一个集合或一份清单
senses.example: The possible answers form a short and exhaustible list.
senses.exampleCN: 可能的答案构成一份很短、可以列尽的清单。
senses.why: If every case can be taken out of a subject until none is left, the list has been drained, and the adjective means able to be listed completely.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个题目里的每一种情形都能被取出直到不剩，这份清单就被「抽干」了，形容词于是表示「可以被列尽」。

intro.en: Exhaustible comes from Latin exhaurire, to drain out, built from ex-, out, and haurire, to draw water, plus the English suffix -ible.
intro.cn: exhaustible 来自拉丁语 exhaurire（抽干），由 ex-（向外）与 haurire（汲水）构成，再加英语后缀 -ible。

items.en: Haurire means to draw water or to drain a vessel.
items.cn: haurire 意为汲水，或把容器里的水舀干。

items.en: Exhaurire adds ex-, out, and means to drain dry or to use up.
items.cn: exhaurire 加上 ex-（向外），意为抽干、用尽。

items.en: Exhaustus, the past participle, means drained or used up.
items.cn: 过去分词 exhaustus 意为已被抽干、已被用尽。

items.en: English borrows exhaust from the Latin participle.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语分词借入 exhaust。

items.en: The suffix -ible forms exhaustible, and in- forms its opposite.
items.cn: 后缀 -ible 构成 exhaustible，前缀 in- 构成它的反义词。

items.en: Modern English applies it to resources, patience, wells, and lists.
items.cn: 现代英语把它用在资源、耐心、水井与清单上。

note.en: Exhaustible belongs with exhaust and inexhaustible, and with adjectives such as finite and depletable.
note.cn: exhaustible 与 exhaust、inexhaustible 同族，也与 finite、depletable 这类形容词相邻。

normal.en: Haurire is the Latin verb for drawing water.
normal.cn: haurire 就是拉丁语「汲水」的动词。

normal.en: Exhaurire drains the vessel, and exhaustus is its past participle.
normal.cn: exhaurire 把容器抽干，exhaustus 是它的过去分词。

normal.en: The suffix -ible means able to be, so exhaustible means able to be drained.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ible 表示「可以被…」，所以 exhaustible 就是「可以被抽干的」。

normal.en: In- before the adjective reverses it into inexhaustible.
normal.cn: 在形容词前加 in-，就翻转成 inexhaustible。

normal.en: Economics calls coal and oil exhaustible resources.
normal.cn: 经济学把煤和石油叫作可耗尽的资源。

abstract.en: See a bucket emptied spoon by spoon until the bottom shows.
abstract.cn: 想象一只桶被一勺一勺舀空，直到看见桶底。

abstract.en: See a battery bar shrink to an empty outline.
abstract.cn: 想象电池图标缩成一个空心轮廓。

abstract.en: See a well rope come up dry.
abstract.cn: 想象并绳拉上来时是干的。

examples.en: Coal is an exhaustible fuel, so the price rises as the seams thin.
examples.cn: 煤是可耗尽的燃料，所以矿层变薄时价格就上涨。

examples.en: The report separates exhaustible resources from renewable ones.
examples.cn: 这份报告把可耗尽的资源与可再生资源区分开来。

examples.en: Years of night shifts had left him thoroughly exhausted.
examples.cn: 多年的夜班使他疲惫不堪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊格佐斯提波」——桶被舀到见底，就是可耗尽的；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ haurire（汲水、抽水）→ exhaurire（抽干）→ 过去分词 exhaustus → 英语 exhaust → exhaustible（加 -ible，可被抽干的），核心义「能被抽到见底」。

sensesIntro.en: Exhaustible keeps the image of draining a vessel and applies it to resources, to patience, to wells, and to lists that can be emptied of cases.
sensesIntro.cn: exhaustible 保留「把容器抽干」的意象，分别用在资源、耐心、水井，以及可以被逐条列尽的清单上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bucket drained until the bottom shows.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只桶被舀到见底。

branches.en: A fuel that can be drained is the resource sense.
branches.cn: 能被抽干的燃料，是资源义。

branches.en: A store of patience that runs low is the feeling sense.
branches.cn: 被消耗到见底的耐心，是情感存量义。

branches.en: A well or a tank is the oldest, most literal sense.
branches.cn: 水井与水罐是最古老、最字面的义项。

branches.en: A subject emptied of every case is the logic sense.
branches.cn: 一个题目被列尽所有情形，是逻辑上的义项。

branches.en: Both a fuel and a temper can be drained until nothing is left.
branches.cn: 燃料与脾气都能被抽到一点不剩。

intro.cn: exhaustible 是 exhaurire 加 -ible，周围有 exhaust、exhaustion 与 inexhaustible。

latinIntro.cn: haurire 意为汲水，exhaurire 意为把水抽干。

items.meaning: to drain out, to use up

items.example: Exhaustus is the participle behind exhaust.

items.example: The suffix -ible adds the idea of possibility.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ible 加上「可能性」的意思。

items.meaning: to use up or tire out

definition_en: extreme tiredness, or the state of having been used up until nothing is left
